name: adv_domain_heat_electrical_rejected
source:
// Heat port (T, Qdot) connected to an electrical port (V, I) must HARD-FAIL.
ThermalSource HOT(T = 400)
Resistor      R1(a1, b1, R = 100)
Ground        GND(b1)
connect(HOT.port, R1.a)
t = HOT.port.T

error.message: connect(hot.port, r1.a): cannot connect a heat port (hot.port) to a electrical port (r1.a) — different physical domains. Couple domains through a transducer component (a motor, pump, heating resistor, …), not a direct connect.
